title: Standable Cubes
description:
Standable Cubes allows you to stand on the new Sulfur Cubes if they contain a block inside.
Stand on Cubes!
body:
# Standable Cubes 🧊
![Player standing on Sulfur Cube](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b11dd1b71674803ed4b3d08a0c68ad37267a06b3.png)

----

### How it works:
Any player can stand on Sulfur Cubes if they contain a block. To prevent players from standing on the cube, the block must be removed from the Sulfur Cube.

----

### How to uninstall:
No longer wish to use this feature? Then run the command `/function stcubes:uninstall` to remove it.
Removing the feature without running this command will result in unintended behavior!

----

![Player standing on Sulfur Cube (Edge)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c0ff41f9bcaae2f440168b5707173733ac607d81.png)
